laws.rule: In Teide National Park (Tenerife), the summit trail PNT 10 Telesforo Bravo and trails PNT 07, 09, 23 and 28 need a free permit booked on Tenerife ON; slots open each Monday at 7 am Canary time for the next 56 days. Carry the permit and your passport, bring high-mountain gear, and stay on marked trails. A cable car ticket does not include the summit permit. Not cancelling an unused booking brings a three-month ban on new permits. Bivouacking is allowed only in four authorised areas with a permit.
laws.heading: Parque Nacional del Teide, Gobierno de Canarias

laws.rule: Whale and dolphin watching in the Canary Islands is regulated by the regional Decree 178/2000 (6 September 2000). Boats must keep their distance from whales and dolphins: no approach within 60 metres, no entering the water to swim or dive within 500 metres, no chasing, circling, feeding or touching them, no going faster than 4 knots within 500 metres, no more than 30 minutes within 100 metres, and no more than three boats within 500 metres. Jet skis may not watch whales or dolphins within 500 metres, and motorised aerial watching is banned below 500 metres. Licensed tourist boats must fly the "Barco Azul / Blue Boat" flag. The decree text is the 2000 publication; later amendments were not checked.
laws.penalty_signal: administrative sanctions under the regional tourism, transport and ecological-impact laws; amounts not stated in this decree text

laws.rule: Mogán (Gran Canaria) charges a municipal tourist stay tax of EUR 0.15 per person per day (about A$0.24 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). The council approved it on 12 December 2024. Property owners pay it to the council, so it reaches a guest through the accommodation price. Reports say a court suspended it for a short time in March 2025 and that it was later allowed to proceed; the ordinance and current rate were not read, so check the Ayuntamiento de Mogán.

Timanfaya National Park (Lanzarote): the park's visitor page says no drones, and asks visitors not to take away volcanic material. The 12 km Ruta de los Volcanes is a guided route booked through the national parks reservation site.
